newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Group Five to take 100 pct Everite.
newsitem.headline: Group Five to take 100 pct Everite.

text.p: Group Five Holdings Ltd said on Monday it planned to take over 100 percent of its Everite Group Ltd building materials subsidiary.
Group Five currently owns 50.1 percent of Everite Holdings, which in turns holds 57.4 percent of Everite Group.
The company said Evhold and Everite shareholders would be offered one new Group Five share for every two Evhold or Everite shares held.
The absorption of Everite would result in cost savings, provide great flexibility and increase transparency by simplying group structure, Group Five said in a statement.
